description: npm audit advisories the CI gate (scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs) may ignore. Each entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date; an expired entry fails CI so exceptions cannot rot. Remove an entry as soon as a fixed version is available.

advisories.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS via deeply nested glob patterns. Every braces version (<=3.0.3) is affected and no patched release exists. Reached only through dev/build tooling (tailwindcss@3 via chokidar/micromatch, eslint-config-next via fast-glob@3.3.1), which runs on repo-controlled patterns; the production dependency tree (npm audit --omit=dev) is clean. Upgrading Tailwind to v4 would not clear it because @next/eslint-plugin-next pins fast-glob@3.3.1.
